record.question: Which artist sought to depict the Idealist Lansdcape?
record.explanation: Canova and Flaxman were Neoclassical sculptors and Durer a Northern Renaissance printmaker/painter, leaving Edwin Church as the only landscape painter; as leader of the Hudson River School he painted luminous, idealized wilderness landscapes (e.g., The Heart of the Andes) that sought to depict an ideal landscape. Medium confidence because the exact term 'idealist landscape' classically belongs to the Claude Lorrain/Poussin ideal-landscape tradition, which is not among the options.
